t.zh: 板上是你当前的<part-ref to="lemma:elimGen"></part-ref>。<level-ref to="decl-ex"></level-ref>的引入规则 ⋀x. ⟦?P(x)⟧ ⟹ ∃y. ?P(y) 先任取一样东西 x：在生成器里，它是约束了 x 的规则，不是一条普通的规则，「替换结论」不接受它。
t.en: The board holds your <part-ref to="lemma:elimGen"></part-ref> as it is now. The intro rule of <level-ref to="decl-ex"></level-ref>, ⋀x. ⟦?P(x)⟧ ⟹ ∃y. ?P(y), first takes any thing x: in the generator it is a rule binding x, not a plain rule, and Swap conclusion does not accept it.

t.zh: 新元件「保留⋀」是一个框：规则以约束变量开头时，框里处理其后的规则，输出时在前面放回同样的约束变量；没有约束变量时，框里直接处理输入。
t.en: The new part Keep ⋀ is a frame: when a rule begins with bound variables, the frame works on the rule after them and puts the same bound variables back in front of its output; when there are none, the frame works on the input itself.

brief.zh: 升级消去规则生成器，使引入规则带约束变量时也能生成消去规则。
brief.en: Upgrade the elimination rule generator so that it also works when an intro rule has bound variables.

hint.zh: 比一比「存在」的引入规则和要生成的那种情况：哪一部分没有变？
hint.en: Compare the intro rule of “there is” with the case to make: which part stays the same?

after.zh: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>要给那样东西起一个新名字，原因就在这里。
after.en: This is why <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> gives that thing a new name.
